info.title: Mishwark Backend API
info.description:
Mishwark car-rental & chauffeur booking backend.

Base URL: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`

Authentication: JWT Bearer token from `POST /auth/otp/verify`. Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Dev OTP bypass code: `0000`.

post.summary: A driver can attach the papers here as file fields nationalIdFront, nationalIdBack, licenseFront, licenseBack, criminalRecord: they are stored privately and the response lists them in `documents` (PENDING, or FAILED with the reason; a bad file never undoes the signup). Other file fields are dropped. Create a customer or driver account. Multipart/form-data - fields may arrive as JSON strings or files. The `role` flag defaults to 'customer'; admin roles cannot be self-assigned.

post.summary: Email/password sign-in, step 1. Limits: 5 wrong passwords for one account from one device (IP) block that device from that account for 15 minutes (429, `errors.retryAfterSeconds`); the owner on another device is unaffected. 403 for a disabled account. Never returns a session: it answers with the next step and a `loginToken` (signed, 5 minutes): `passwordChangeRequired` (temporary password: call /auth/set-password), `twoFactorSetupRequired` (with `secret` + `qrCodeDataURL`: call /auth/verify-2fa-setup) or `twoFactorRequired` (call /auth/verify-2fa). 400 on a wrong email or password.

post.summary: PUBLIC. Server-side price. Send `serviceType` (WEDDING, TRIP, VIP) with `vehicleId`: WEDDING/VIP = the car's own fixed price (or the default) covering included hours and km, plus every started extra hour (send `startTime`/`endTime`) and every extra km; TRIP = from the company (Settings origin, unless startPoint is sent) to a listed `destinationId` (fixed price per car category) or to `endPoint` (the category's "another place" price), plus extra km beyond the included ones. The response adds `lines` (itemised: wedding|vip|trip|trip_other, extra_hours, extra_km, package_discount, referral_discount with quantity, unitPrice, included), `bookedMinutes`, `depositRate`, `destination`, the points used and `route` (source haversine = straight-line estimate). Without serviceType the older per-km price applies. 400 for a retired car or an inactive destination.

post.summary: PUBLIC. Resolves startPoint/endPoint (coordinates or a place name) into distanceKm and durationMinutes. Coordinates are passed through; free text is geocoded via OpenRouteService. Without ORS_API_KEY the server falls back to a straight-line estimate and says so in `source` and `warning`.

post.summary: Creates a booking (PENDING). Send `serviceType` (WEDDING, TRIP, VIP) and, for a trip, `destinationId` (then startPoint/endPoint are optional: the trip starts at the company and ends at the destination). Priced exactly like POST /bookings/estimate-price; the booking keeps `serviceType`, `destinationId` and `priceLines`. An endTime earlier than startTime means the trip ends the next morning (e.g. 22:00 to 01:00); it must end by Settings `overnightLatestEndHour` (default 06:00; 400 otherwise, and 0 turns trips past midnight off). Also 400 for a trip shorter than `minTripMinutes` (default 30), more than `maxAdvanceBookingDays` ahead (default 365), or a start more than 15 minutes in the past today. Clashes with the car, the driver or maintenance are checked across midnight. Only the car's own drivers can drive it: a chosen driver must be one of them (400 "This driver isn't assigned to this car"); otherwise the main driver is tried first, then the others. 400 "This car has no driver assigned yet", 400 on a retired car or a maintenance day, 409 when the car is too close to another trip or none of its drivers is free.

get.summary: Cancels a booking (DELETE). Settles the money paid by the cancellation policy (Settings `freeCancellationHours`, default 48): cancelled that long before the start, everything paid goes back to the customer's wallet; later, the deposit is kept and anything above it goes back. An admin may send `refundDeposit: true|false` to decide either way (ignored from a customer). The booking gets `cancelledAt`, `depositOutcome` (REFUNDED, KEPT or null when nothing was paid) and `depositRefunded`; the response also has `cancellation` (paid, refund, kept). Releases availability & driver and promotes waitlist position #1. Cancelling twice changes nothing.

get.summary: Dashboard bookings page. `q` matches a reference (MW-1A2B3C), the customer's name or phone (01…, +20… or 0020…). Filters: `status`, `paymentStatus`, `scope` (upcoming = today onwards, soonest first [default]; past = latest first; all), `from`/`to` (YYYY-MM-DD), `page`, `limit` (max 100).
